summary: Provides a centralized reporting page for all admission follow-ups, allowing users to view and track follow-ups categorized by status (Today's, Upcoming, Overdue, Completed) and filter them by a specific date range.
steps: Navigate to the Admission Follow-up page.
View follow-ups categorized as: 'Today's Follow-up', 'Upcoming Follow-ups', 'Overdue Follow-ups' (pending), and 'Completed Follow-ups'.
Filter follow-ups by setting a start date and end date to analyze activities within a specific period.
important_notes: This page serves as a comprehensive report for all follow-up activities, enabling effective monitoring and management.
questions: Where can I find a consolidated view of all admission follow-ups?
How do I check for overdue follow-ups?
Can I filter admission follow-ups by a specific date range?
What are the different categories of follow-ups displayed on this page?
